title: Combat toggle
description: A simple Minecraft plugin that lets OPs toggle PvP combat on or off with commands, broadcasting the status to all players and preventing combat when disabled.
body:
Combat Toggle
Combat Toggle is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows server operators to instantly enable or disable PvP combat with simple commands.

Features
✅ PvP enabled by default

✅ /combat on — Enables player combat

✅ /combat off — Disables player combat

✅ Server-wide broadcast messages when combat status changes

✅ Only OP players can use the commands

✅ Prevents all player-to-player damage when combat is disabled

✅ Saves combat status across server restarts

✅ Lightweight and easy to use

✅ Compatible with modern Minecraft server versions

Commands
Command	Description
/combat on	Enable PvP combat
/combat off	Disable PvP combat
Permissions
Only server operators (OPs) can use Combat Toggle commands.
